comment: Dr. Archer is a great professor. The lectures are very interesting and she explains the material in a clear manner. The workload is not too much; as long as you put a good effort in, you can receive a good grade. Also, she is always looking to get to know the students better.

Archer is a great teacher and cares about each student succeeding. The workload is not bad at all, and its very easy to participate in class. You can definitely go outside of class to talk to her and she also likes to get to know her students. The lectures are interesting and she uses a lot of current events and real life examples which is great.

The best professor I have had at UR thus far. I never wanted to miss class because I loved her lectures. There was lots of reading but it was interesting stuff. Had awesome conversations with her outside class as well. I have a newfound appreciation for political science because of her. Take her class!
